content_blocks.label: clause_1._Factual_Background
content_blocks.text: On March 1, 2023, Plaintiff entered into a contract with Defendant for the provision of software development services.

content_blocks.label: clause_2._Breach_of_Contract
content_blocks.text: Defendant failed to complete the project as per the agreed timeline, resulting in a material breach of the contract.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Remedy_Sought
content_blocks.text: Plaintiff seeks damages in the amount of $75,000 and specific performance of the contract.
